osm_tags.description: Peet Alberts Rock Engravings, National Monument. 1,200 to 1,500 engravings can be found here, mostly animals, but also abstracts like circular forms and a star. The koppie used to be good look-out post for hunters.
osm_tags.name: Peet Alberts Koppie

osm_tags.description: Lake Oponona (Ndonga: the one that swallowed up all the water) is a natural lake in the Cuvelai Basin. It holds water up to the following rainy season in a prosperous year.
osm_tags.name: Lake Oponono
